title: Reopened 5,293 stalled fraud investigations after the Amazon Pay launch
summary: After the Amazon Pay launch, 5,927 investigations had missed their SLA with too few investigators to clear them, and those customers could not create wallets; I designed and built a tool that reopened them for investigators in record time.
what_would_have_happened: Thousands of customers stay blocked from creating wallets while an understaffed team works the backlog by hand.
the_call: Build a generic bulk tool quickly and let investigators spend their time on the cases themselves.
what_i_did: Designed and built a command-line bulk action tool, ran it against all 5,927 tasks and accounted for every failure.
what_changed: 5,293 investigations went back to investigators, the weekly report recorded the delivery as on time, and the tool was later extended for another use case.

metrics.label: reopened for investigators
metrics.context: the rest were already resolved or invalid
